name: Sad Pablo Escobar
look: Three stills of Wagner Moura as Pablo Escobar in Narcos, waiting alone. Top: he slumps on a yellow porch swing staring at nothing. Bottom left: he sits by himself at a table in a dim kitchen. Bottom right: he stands alone beside an empty swimming pool.
use: The captions describe someone waiting for something that never comes, or feeling left out and alone, with the three stills stretching out a long, lonely, bored wait.
slots: the wait goes on (bottom left panel)
examples: Me in the car after everyone said they were ready
Me waiting for someone to laugh at my joke
